title: Atari Masterpieces Vol. II
statusNote: Logos, title and menus work. All eight arcade games start from Choose Game (Asteroids Deluxe, Centipede, Crystal Castles, Liberator, Pong, Space Duel, Tempest, Warlords); Asteroids Deluxe was played: the ship turns, thrusts and fires. The four Atari 2600 extras are locked until score targets are met, as on the console.
notes: Each game opens on its arcade attract screen; press 1 to start a one-player game.
Either soft key pauses a game. The pause menu has Control Keys (that game's keys, which can be changed there), Game Settings, and Quit Game to go back to the game list.
Air-Sea Battle, Canyon Bomber, Miniature Golf and Video Checkers (Atari 2600) unlock by reaching a score in Liberator, Warlords, Centipede and Tempest.
N-Gage Arena is no longer online, so its menu entry does nothing useful here.

controls.source: Each game's Control Keys screen in its pause menu (defaults). Movement on the direction pad is not listed there, except left and right in Tempest; it was confirmed in Asteroids Deluxe (turn and thrust) and is assumed for the other games.

actions.up: Menus: move up. Games: thrust (Asteroids Deluxe, Space Duel), otherwise move up
actions.down: Menus: move down. Games: move down
actions.rsk: Back (menus); pause menu (in a game), resume (pause menu)
actions.2: Two-player start (Asteroids Deluxe, Centipede, Crystal Castles, Liberator, Tempest)
actions.5: Fire (Asteroids Deluxe, Centipede, Liberator, Space Duel, Tempest); jump (Crystal Castles); catch (Warlords)
actions.7: Shields (Asteroids Deluxe, Liberator, Space Duel); Super Zapper (Tempest)

notes: Arcade layout: arrows move, Space is the fire key (5), S is shields or the Super Zapper (7), 1 starts a game, Escape pauses. On a gamepad Start begins a game, X or the right trigger fires and Y or the left trigger is shields.
